title: Hold a business licence to trade in national parks and reserves
what: Sell goods or provide services in reserved Crown land (national parks and reserves) only under a business licence.

laws.title: National Parks and Reserves Management Act 2002 (Tas)

sources.title: National Parks and Reserves Management Act 2002 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person who is not the holder of a business licence must not, in reserved land that is also Crown land – (a) sell or hire out, offer or expose for sale or hiring out, or have in his or her possession for selling or hiring out, any article, material or other thing; or (b) provide, offer to provide or hold himself or herself out as willing to provide any service or facility

sources.title: National Parks and Reserves Management Act 2002 (Tas)
sources.locator: s 3, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: managing authority means the managing authority for reserved land, as specified in section 29 ;

reach.condition: if it sells goods or provides services in Tasmanian national parks or reserves
